inputs.text: [dry, precise, fussy, deadpan] Wonderful. Now I'll need evidence... of the evidence.
[misty-eyed, moved, voice cracking] The evidence... it was all there.
[misty-eyed, moved, voice cracking, after a pause] I don't know what to do with my hands.

voice.name: Designed B
voice.about: An American corporate auditor of about sixty. Dry, precise and fussy: clipped consonants, a faintly nasal, pedantic tone, slow and deliberate, the kind of man who asks for evidence of the evidence. Clean studio microphone.
